body.p: The Hub Die is the central building block to develop the NVL products. It contains all of the traditional client IPs. 4 Atom core are present on this die. It does contain the Die to Die (D2D) links to connect to the other die to form the products. Hub Die is common across all NVL SKUs except NVL AX (HUB AX) and RZL WS (MH-W).
